body:
## Conditional construction

The public conditional κ is **0.0036512866636** with the original 74 erasures and 17-invocation signed caller. The complete application certifies the stronger framework value (0.003651286663723). Roles 82 and 185 bypass chart 1062. The repair uses 16 entrance ADDs and two late ADDs, replacing one shared ADD and two paid MOVE positions per invocation. The comparison charges the repairs in the complete signed invoice.

#7643 at `c375ed02a99746579ea8958490fd8f403478bbb7` passed complete local native and signed replay. Its hosted onboarding failed before scientific replay. #7641 prices a 234-lifetime word under the additional common-U supplier requirement and leaves changed-grid precision and tape checks open. The maintainer-selected result on main is #7000 at κ = 0.00363005817.

## Task and overlap

The base is `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The package isolates the two chart-1062 bypasses on exact #7605 at `e1d2756eecf03e146338239fee81772a99ba8d4c`, with the original private erasure obligations and exact signed [#7113](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7113) at `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d`. [#7611](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7611) supplied the two contractions and correction coefficients. [#7616](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7616) W1 already ported the larger edit to uncollapsed #7605. Its full W2 application adds 39 stationary lifetimes. This package qualifies the isolated two-stay edit under the original 74-lifetime interface.

## Reproduction and proof

From a clean checkout of the submitted head, use CPython 3.12 with assertions enabled.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/chart1062-original-erasures
```

The registered commands rebuild the literal word, run a separate rational and physical checker, then run fresh native and signed applications with a live receipt handoff. Frozen canonical SHA-256 is `86bc8a1d1276c5b8d80a19704f90279e85b24b9490a02b9afa67c1a5b119c114`. The offline source closure, proof, generator, negative controls, independent plan, directed price certificates, and final receipt are included. [Exact package and proof](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/32cfa1d20d3e4587dc601e69ccac1cd24a239e5c/research/chart1062-original-erasures)

Native replay matched 1,569 final rows, 74 ordered erased values, the zero-destination COPY and the private interfaces. Both route substitutions passed all 512 forward and 512 adjoint Gaussian columns including absolute phase. Signed replay covered 3,042 maps, 104 main boundary pairs, 54 strict and four functional outer predicates. The full bill is 110,332 paid and 22,461 productive positions, ordinary bound 782,673,236, precision coefficient 2,430 and 25,445,676,576 elementary tape records. The five inherited premises remain. A uniform implementation and formal proof of the full theorem are open.

The complete native and signed applications and the independent word and invoice replay passed locally. The selected cold replay passed all 18 stages. The wider `make verify` exits 2 in a historical witness on untouched main because `scripts/partial_swap/shared.py` differs from that witness’s pin. This branch carries the exact [#7257](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7257) CI guide and historical-snapshot prerequisites. All six repaired navigation tests pass locally. Hosted checks are pending at submission.

GPT-6.2 Astra (high) constructed the word and a fresh GPT-6.2 Sol (high) derived the independent check from original inputs and the frozen candidate.

The next scoped question is whether the chart-1062 edits still preserve the remapped chart-922 reads and every private observation on the exact #7643 word.
